messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] prod /v1/generate-stream p99 latency > SLO (eu-west-1). condition=latency_slo_breach sustained 6m. p95=1.7s p99=5.2s. streaming stalls reported in trace logs. pager -> @Sanjay Patel

Sanjay Patel: Oncall - looking. I can reproduce elevated preproc times on preproc-prod-02. CPU tops around 95% and prom shows long prompt_assembly_ms spikes correlated with JSON-mode requests.

Eve Chen: adding logs and quick grep. seeing repeated template expansion of tool schemas inside prompts. a few requests are pulling full tool schema into template rendering (huge). sample from logs:

```
2026-03-15T12:01:23Z preproc-prod-02 preproc INFO expanded_prompt_size=196480 bytes tokens_est=10234 template_id=tool_schema_v3 request_id=abc123
2026-03-15T12:01:23Z preproc-prod-02 tokenizer WARN estimated_token_split=10234 actual_tokenize_time_ms=430
2026-03-15T12:01:24Z runtime-stream WARN stream_stall_detected token_index=0 duration_ms=1200 request_id=abc123
```

Eve Chen: tl;dr — a subset of requests cause template expansion to blow up (large JSON tool schemas + template glue) which massively increases tokenization time and stalls streaming.

Rajiv Kumar: Proposing quick mitigation: disable JSON-mode parsing for the streaming route and apply an upstream size cap on expanded templates. Patch I can push now: `rt flag set /v1/generate-stream disable_json_mode=true --scope=prod`

DeployBot: rollout started: routing 30% traffic to model-variant:small-quantized for low-latency fallback. Config change: `route /v1/generate-stream -> fallback=small-quantized,threshold=30%`

Sanjay Patel: Applying Rajiv's runtime flag now. Running health checks.

Sanjay Patel: Quick results: p99 dropped from 5.2s -> 1.1s within 2 minutes after disable_json_mode + fallback routing. p95 still elevated (~1.5s). streaming stalls reduce but still some tail.

Maya (CS): We're triaging customer reports: three customers (acct: acme, medai-inc, searchly) reported stalls and partial streams. CS will notify impacted customers with initial ETA and mitigation summary.

Eve Chen: Evidence suggests two compounding factors: (1) prompt/template expansion pulling full tool schema into the prompt (size explosion), (2) tokenizer pre-scan cost scales non-linearly with token candidates when expansion is extreme. Need immediate guardrails on expansion size + streaming backpressure improvements.

Rajiv Kumar: For immediate safety I've added a server-side cap: `TEMPLATE_EXPANSION_MAX_BYTES=16KB` and a soft-fail path that returns structured error to the client if exceeded. Pushed to canary.

DeployBot: Config updated on canary. No errors yet. Monitoring for error rate spike.

Lina Gomez: I'm taking the handoff at 12:08UTC (Sanjay - thanks). I'll own until 13:00UTC. Lina -> I will: 1) hold mitigation state, 2) validate canary, 3) coordinate postmortem.

Sanjay Patel: Handoff ack. Notes in the thread: mitigation=disable_json_mode + fallback routing + template size cap. QA: reduced p99 but keep watch on p95 and any 500s returned by soft-fail.

Lina Gomez: Next steps (short):
- keep `disable_json_mode=true` until we have patch for streaming backpressure or template streaming optimization.
- escalate to eng-ml to review tokenizer pre-scan algorithm (Rajiv/Eve to loop in).
- prepare rollback playbook if errors spike > 1% or customer impact grows.
- notify owners for postmortem: eng-runtime, eng-ml, devex (prompt templates).

Eve Chen: noted for eng-ml. I'll attach the sample requests and the log excerpts to the incident ticket. suspected trigger: tool-schema-with-array-fields + template helpers that iterate over entire schema.

Maya (CS): Sending customer-facing note now: short summary + mitigation + ETA for a postmortem. I'll paste in ticket numbers once sent.

Rajiv Kumar: Longer-term fixes I propose: streaming-friendly template expansion (stream expansions rather than build-and-tokenize full string), tokenizer incremental tokenization + early abort heuristics, and validation on prompt-template inputs in devex.

Lina Gomez: Agree. For the immediate oncall window I'll keep `disable_json_mode=true` and monitor dashboards: <https://dashboards.internal/reports/latency/v1_generate_stream> and traces: <https://tracing.internal/trace?service=preproc&name=prompt_expand>.

Sanjay Patel: Closing loop for now. If any new regression appears ping `@incidents` and escalate to pager. I'll update runbook with the temporary template cap and mitigation commands.

Lina Gomez: Filing action-items for postmortem: *root-cause analysis*, *deploy streaming-optimized expansion*, *devex template lints*, *customer communications*. Assign owners in the incident tracker.

DeployBot: incident annotated: mitigation_applied=disable_json_mode,fallback_route,template_cap; status=stabilized; incident_id=INC-20260315-042.

Lina Gomez: Putting a short watch on it for next 45m, then will hand back to rotation. If stable, we'll convert to postmortem and link docs.

Maya (CS): Customers notified. will update when they reply.

Eve Chen: attaching the problematic request sample to the incident ticket now. I'll start drafting a small benchmark reproducer for eng-ml.

Sanjay Patel: Thanks team. End of active triage.
